title: Shizukaol C alleviates trimethylamine oxide-induced inflammation through activating Keap1-Nrf2-GSTpi pathway in vascular smooth muscle cell.
authors: Dong, Xiaoliang; Qu, Lu; Xiong, Juan; Wang, Bingxin; Sha, Xiaowei; Wu, Bo; Sun, Yudong; Pan, Xiaohua; Sun, Jia; Pan, Li-Long
journal: Phytomedicine : international journal of phytotherapy and phytopharmacology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然化合物Shizukaol C通过Keap1-Nrf2-GSTpi通路缓解TMAO诱导的血管炎症，核心是蛋白-小分子互作与信号通路，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，且方法以湿实验为主，仅含分子对接但非针对核酸体系。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Cardiovascular disease is one of the main causes of global mortality, and there is an urgent need for effective treatment strategies. Gut microbiota-dependent metabolite trimethylamine-N-oxide (TMAO) promotes the development of cardiovascular diseases, and shizukaol C, a natural sesquiterpene isolated from Chloranthus multistachys with various biological activities, might exhibit beneficial role in preventing TMAO-induced vascular inflammation. PURPOSE: The purpose of this study was to investigate the anti-inflammatory effects and the underlying mechanisms of shizukaol C on TMAO-induced vascular inflammation. METHODS: The effect and underlying mechanism of shizukaol C on TMAO-induced adhesion molecules expression, bone marrow-derived macrophages (BMDM) adhesion to VSMC were evaluated by western blot, cell adhesion assay, co-immunoprecipitation, immunofluorescence assay, and quantitative Real-Time PCR, respectively. To verify the role of shizukaol C in vivo, TMAO-induced vascular inflammation model were established using guidewire-induced injury on mice carotid artery. Changes in the intima area and the expression of GSTpi, VCAM-1, CD68 were examined using haematoxylin-eosin staining, and immunofluorescence assay. RESULTS: Our data demonstrated that shizukaol C significantly suppressed TMAO-induced adhesion molecule expression and the bone marrow-derived macrophages (BMDM) adhesion in vascular smooth muscle cells (VSMC). Mechanically, shizukaol C inhibited TMAO-induced c-Jun N-terminal kinase (JNK)-nuclear factor-kappa B (NF-kappaB)/p65 activation, and the JNK inhibition was dependent on the shizukaol C-mediated glutathione-S-transferase pi (GSTpi) expression. By further molecular docking and protein-binding analysis, we demonstrated that shizukaol C directly binds to Keap1 to induce Nrf2 nuclear translocation and upregulated GSTpi expression. Consistently, our in vivo experiment showed that shizukaol C elevated the expression level of GSTpi in carotid arteries and alleviates TMAO-induced vascular inflammation. CONCLUSION: Shizukaol C exerts anti-inflammatory effects in TMAO-treated VSMC by targeting Keap1 and activating Nrf2-GSTpi signaling and resultantly inhibits the downstream JNK-NF-kappaB/p65 activation and VSMC adhesion, and alleviates TMAO-induced vascular inflammation in vivo, suggesting that shizukaol C may be a potential drug for treating TMAO-induced vascular diseases.
abstract_zh: 背景：心血管疾病是全球死亡的主要原因之一，亟需有效的治疗策略。肠道微生物依赖性代谢物氧化三甲胺（TMAO）促进心血管疾病的发展，而shizukaol C是一种从多穗金粟兰（Chloranthus multistachys）中分离的天然倍半萜，具有多种生物活性，可能在预防TMAO诱导的血管炎症中发挥有益作用。目的：本研究旨在探讨shizukaol C对TMAO诱导的血管炎症的抗炎作用及其潜在机制。方法：通过western blot、细胞粘附实验、免疫共沉淀、免疫荧光实验和定量实时PCR，分别评估shizukaol C对TMAO诱导的粘附分子表达及骨髓来源巨噬细胞（BMDM）粘附至血管平滑肌细胞（VSMC）的影响和潜在机制。为验证shizukaol C在体内的作用，利用导丝诱导的小鼠颈动脉损伤建立TMAO诱导的血管炎症模型。通过苏木精-伊红染色和免疫荧光实验检测内膜面积变化及GSTpi、VCAM-1、CD68的表达。结果：我们的数据表明，shizukaol C显著抑制TMAO诱导的粘附分子表达及骨髓来源巨噬细胞（BMDM）在血管平滑肌细胞（VSMC）上的粘附。机制上，shizukaol C抑制TMAO诱导的c-Jun N末端激酶（JNK）-核因子-κB（NF-κB）/p65激活，且JNK抑制依赖于shizukaol C介导的谷胱甘肽S-转移酶pi（GSTpi）表达。通过进一步的分子对接和蛋白结合分析，我们证明shizukaol C直接结合Keap1以诱导Nrf2核转位并上调GSTpi表达。一致地，我们的体内实验显示，shizukaol C提高颈动脉中GSTpi的表达水平，并减轻TMAO诱导的血管炎症。结论：Shizukaol C通过靶向Keap1并激活Nrf2-GSTpi信号，在TMAO处理的VSMC中发挥抗炎作用，从而抑制下游JNK-NF-κB/p65激活和VSMC粘附，并在体内减轻TMAO诱导的血管炎症，提示shizukaol C可能是治疗TMAO诱导的血管疾病的潜在药物。
